rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday choice for cold or chilly weather and things that feel icy.

example.english: It's so frosty today that I don't want to go out.

rows.note: Use this when frost has actually formed on or inside an object, such as a drink or container.

example.english: The soda got frosty inside after being left in the freezer.

rows.note: Use this for a person's cold, unfriendly manner rather than for physical temperature.

example.english: They were frosty toward the guests and clearly didn't want to be welcoming.
